labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports unexpected behaviour (a suspected deadlock) with a detailed analysis.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example or rich.diagnose output; the report is not reproducible yet.

body:
Thanks for the detailed analysis. To investigate a possible deadlock we need a minimal runnable example that reproduces it without third-party code. A short script that uses `Live(..., redirect_stdout=True, redirect_stderr=True, auto_refresh=True)`, with a background thread printing or logging while the display refreshes, would be ideal. Stack dumps alone do not show us how to reproduce the lock ordering.

Please also paste the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`. You already listed Rich 14.2.0 and Linux, but that report confirms the environment.

The redirect options are described in the [Live docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
